title: Group sums compare decimals exactly and keep entries separate
proves: An observed group can have one row or many. Integer, float and decimal-string amounts sum exactly.
Reference amounts compare exactly with the group totals. A listed group with no rows sums to zero, including when the entire subject is empty.
